limitations: Familiarity is an editorial review, not a promise that every player knows every answer.
Time-sensitive examples are reviewed as of 1 November 2026; future events are not presumed to have occurred.

spacingReview.rule: No listed pair occurs on the same or adjacent day, including wraparound.

offlinePolicy: Generous reviewed answer lists and common aliases. No online judge. The lists do not guarantee every conceivable valid answer or phrasing.

provenance.foundation: The 50 owner-approved everyday examples and the earlier expanded accessible source.
provenance.reason: Replace specialist rosters after 1 November Daily feedback; accessibility takes precedence over exhaustive specialist classification.

calendarReview.rule: Continue the original accessible calendar two days after its 30 October epoch, so restored broad prompts do not repeat on adjacent release days.

ratingPolicy.method: Each canonical answer reviewed in its question context. Rounded editorial estimates and ties reflect approximate familiarity, not measured player-popularity percentages.
ratingPolicy.coverage: Every answer has an explicit score. No default 50, random jitter, interpolation by array order or scores copied across unrelated questions.

bands.40-59: Less immediate but readily recognised choices
bands.95-100: Least immediate valid choices in this list

ratingPolicy.ties: Similarly immediate answers can share scores, including 100.
